chapter: Family, the reunion retold and sound effects
title: Early 1972: becoming friends with Chauncey
summary: They date the festival to spring 1972; she and Hazel invited Chauncey to Leisuretown with his marimba, and their romance grew.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: When did you begin taking care of Chauncey?
It must have been early '72. It was, it was early '72. Now that festival must have been May, perhaps June.
So you began taking care of Chauncey just after that.
Became friends with Chauncey. In fact we invited, Hazel and I invited him down to Leisuretown. And we insisted he bring his marimba.
Because - well it was quite a
fascinating instrument and we heard he was with the Merry Macs and all these things.
And everything was evolving from the conversation. And from that grew our romance.
